title: EDGE company introduction
purpose: Introduce EDGE, TerraLens AI, the terrestrial validation plan and the future AstraLens roadmap.
brand_style: credible, calm, technically mature European deep-tech science and innovation documentary; deep navy, charcoal, slate grey and restrained white typography; stable deliberate cinematic documentary camera

narration.voice: clear natural professional male English voice
narration.text: My name is Mirsina Aghdam, CEO of EDGE — Earthwise Dynamics Geo Environs. Europe needs more secure and responsible access to critical minerals. Yet identifying and prioritising promising areas for exploration remains slow, fragmented and expensive. At EDGE, we are developing TerraLens AI: an evidence-led system that brings together drone gamma-ray spectrometry, LiDAR, satellite and hyperspectral data, geochemistry, mineralogy and geological records. The aim is practical. TerraLens AI helps exploration teams identify, assess and prioritise potential rare-earth targets with a clearer, traceable evidence trail. With support from ESA BIC Ireland, we are progressing terrestrial development and preparing field validation across European geological settings, beginning with collaboration opportunities in Sweden. This terrestrial work will provide the foundation for AstraLens: EDGE’s future roadmap for space-enabled mineral intelligence. EDGE combines geoengineering, AI automation and Earth observation to support more informed decisions in the critical-minerals sector.
